credits_spent: free trial, last day of the 7-day window
failures: A9: The follow-up prompt never reached the builder. Both attempts ('make the button dark green', 'change the headline') came back with 'Something went wrong' and the message stayed in the input box.
A10: No export. Softr has no way to download the app or sync it to Git — the app only exists inside Softr.
A12: axe reports one serious violation on the landing page: the account button in the header is labelled 'Your account' while it shows the initials 'MH'.
Not a criterion: the 'Services' link in the navigation returns a 404. The booking page itself is fine.
notes: Softr AI built the whole app from one prompt: landing page with three services and prices, booking form, admin area with search and filters, seeded with ten sample bookings. The form stores the booking under reference BK-11 and the admin list shows it in a fresh session, so the data is real and persistent. Sign-in is by emailed code; our own address was already the admin. Weak points: the follow-up chat is broken, there is no export, and the navigation link to /services is dead. Prices are radio buttons rather than a dropdown, which the brief asked for — same information, different control.
